# Govulncheck accepted advisories
#
# One Go vulnerability ID per line. Blank lines and lines starting with '#'
# are ignored. Every entry here MUST satisfy ALL of the following:
#
#   1. The advisory has no fixed version upstream ("Fixed in: N/A").
#   2. goback does not exercise the vulnerable code path in a way that is
#      exploitable (e.g. server-side daemon bugs reached only through the
#      Docker client SDK, where goback is the client).
#   3. There is an entry in the companion .trivyignore.yaml for the matching
#      CVE so both SAST/dependency scanners stay in sync.
#
# This list is reviewed on every dependency bump. Entries are removed as soon
# as the upstream project ships a fix.
#
# Last reviewed: 2026-07-18
